DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご住所の変更でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。住所だけでなく勤務先も変わりました。通帳を作った時の情報が古いままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所と勤務先の二変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My workplace has changed as well as my address. The information from when I opened the passbook is still out of date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the two changes: your address and workplace. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の勤務先を確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have documents confirming your current workplace?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この資料です。新しい会社名は似ていますが、前の会社の別部署ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新会社が旧会社の部署でないと資料で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. The new company has a similar name, but it is not another department of my former company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the documents to show that the new company is not a department of the old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な更新項目を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff will check which details need updating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。住所変更だけ済ませて、勤務先も更新したと思い込まないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所だけの更新で済ませないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to avoid updating only the address and assuming the workplace has been updated too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not want to stop at updating only the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話番号も変更されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Has your telephone number also changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は同じです。変わった項目と、変わっていない項目を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話は同じで変更項目を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number is the same. I will explain separately which details have changed and which have not.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your telephone number is unchanged and distinguish the changed details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この用紙で更新内容を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the updates on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。住所と勤務先が更新対象に入っているか、最後に見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 更新対象に両項目が入るか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. At the end I will check again that both the address and workplace are included in the updates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that both details are included in the updates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの変更として担当へ引き継ぎます。資料と用紙をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer this to the responsible staff as two changes. Please check the documents and form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この二袋は同じ銘柄ですが、表示が少し違います。どこを比べればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同銘柄二袋の比較箇所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. These two bags have the same brand, but the labels differ a little. Which parts should I compare?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which details to compare on two bags of the same brand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 容量と精米の時期を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check the quantity and when the rice was milled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 容量は同じです。私は一人なので、食べ切れる量と保存場所も考えて選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人分の消費量と保存条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The quantities are the same. I live alone, so I also want to consider how much I can finish and the storage space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your consumption as one person and your storage conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きい袋の方が単価は低いですが、小さい容量もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The larger bag has a lower unit price, but smaller quantities are available too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい袋も見たいです。銘柄が同じだから、買う量まで同じでよいとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小容量も見て銘柄と量を別判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to see the smaller bag. I do not think the same brand means that the amount I buy should also be the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Look at smaller quantities and judge the brand and amount separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いつもどのくらいの頻度で炊きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: How often do you usually cook rice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 週に三回です。大袋を開けたまま長く置くより、必要な量にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 炊飯頻度と少量希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Three times a week. Rather than leaving a large bag open for a long time, I want to buy the amount I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how often you cook rice and that you prefer a smaller quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの小容量を比較できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can compare this smaller quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。容量と精米表示を見て、今回はこの小さい袋にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量精米表示を確認して選択する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After checking the quantity and milling information, I will take this smaller bag this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the quantity and milling label before choosing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらですね。袋の種類と表示を確認してから、会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This one, correct? Please check the bag type and labeling, then take it to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the playground equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。雪で階段の足元が見えません。見た目は壊れていないようですが、使えるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雪で見えない階段の利用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Snow is hiding where you step on the stairs. It does not appear broken, but I want to ask whether it can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether stairs hidden by snow can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用の表示は確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked the signs about use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。子どもには乗らずに待ってもらっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもは未使用で表示未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I have asked my child to wait without getting on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your child has not used it and that you have not checked the signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示と管理の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the signs and the management guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。閉鎖の札が見えないだけで、使ってよいとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閉鎖札不在だけで利用可と判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I will not decide it is safe to use simply because I cannot see a closure sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the absence of a visible closure sign does not establish permission to use it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日は遊具以外で過ごせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you spend today doing something other than using the equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。歩ける通路を短く散歩します。子どもに雪の上から階段を探らせるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遊具を避け見える通路の散歩に変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. We will take a short walk on a passable path. I will not let my child feel for the stairs beneath the snow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid the equipment and switch to walking on a visible path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 靴の状態は大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are your shoes in suitable condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 靴底を確認します。滑りそうなら今日は遊ばず、入口側から帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 靴底と足元が悪ければ帰る条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the soles. If it looks slippery, we will not play today and will leave by the entrance side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will leave if the soles or footing are unsuitable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足元が見える通路をお使いください。遊具は管理の案内を確認してからにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use a path where you can see your footing. Check the management guidance before using the equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お座席のことでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。周りがにぎやかなので、少し離れた席へ移りたいです。空いていても使える席か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 静かな席へ移る希望と利用可能性を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is noisy around me, so I would like to move a little farther away. Even if a seat is empty, I do not know whether I may use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about moving to a quieter seat and whether it is available for use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の券はどの区分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: What category is your own ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。別の席が空いているだけで、予約されていないとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人券区分と空席非予約なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. Another seat being empty does not mean that it is unreserved, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your ticket category and explain that empty does not mean unreserved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空席と利用できる席を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will distinguish empty seats from seats you may use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。先に荷物を置いて確保するのはやめ、今の席で返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に荷物で占有せず返答を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not put my luggage there first to claim it; I will wait for the answer in my current seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not reserve a seat with luggage first; wait for a reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: すぐ近くの方に席を替えるよう頼んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you asked anyone nearby to change seats?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ。ほかの方へ自分で移動を求めるのではなく、自分が移れる席を相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人へ移動要求でなく本人席移動を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I am asking about a seat I can move to, rather than asking other passengers to move myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about moving your own seat rather than asking other people to move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が区分と空きの扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will check the category and how empty seats are handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。移れる席が決まったら、忘れ物がないか見てから荷物を持って移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 許可席が決まってから荷物確認して移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Once a seat I may move to is decided, I will check that I have left nothing behind and take my luggage with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait until an approved seat is decided, then check your belongings and move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 券の区分を確認します。ご案内するまで今の席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check your ticket category. Please wait in your current seat until we advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの窓口のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to consult this counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先に別の窓口で番号札を取りました。こちらへ行くよう案内されましたが、この札を使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 他窓口の番号札を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I already took a queue ticket at another counter. I was directed here, but can I use this ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a queue ticket from another counter can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何の相談で札を取られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What was your inquiry when you took the ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所変更です。ただ、保険の手続きもあるので、こちらへ案内されました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所と保険の二手続きを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: An address change. But I also have insurance procedures, so I was directed here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the two procedures for address and insurance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの手続きの順番を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the order of the two procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。新しい札を取る前に、元の番号が取り消されるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新札取得前に旧番号の扱いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before taking a new ticket, I would also like to ask whether the original number will be canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what happens to the old number before taking a new ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の窓口の受付は済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you completed registration at the original counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞いただけで、書類はまだ出していません。住所変更が終わったと思ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明のみで書類未提出と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only heard an explanation and have not submitted the documents yet. I do not think the address change is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that you only heard an explanation and have not submitted documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ二つの受付状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the responsible staff the registration status of both matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。住所の窓口へ戻る必要があるかも確認し、呼出しを逃さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻る必要と呼出し確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will also check whether I need to return to the address counter so I do not miss my number being called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to go back and how to avoid missing the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 札をお持ちのままお待ちください。受付の順番を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait while keeping your ticket. We will check the order of service and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲んでいる薬についてお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I would like to ask about the medicines you take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 白い錠剤を飲んでいますが、名前を覚えていません。飲み始めてから眠くなることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬名不明と服用後眠気を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I take white tablets, but I do not remember their name. Sometimes I feel sleepy since starting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the medicine name and feel sleepy after taking it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お薬の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have information about your medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手帳があります。白いという見た目だけで、薬の名前を推測しないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見た目で薬を推測せず手帳を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my medicine notebook. I want to avoid guessing the name just because the tablets look white.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not guess from appearance; show your medicine notebook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲み始めた日と、眠気の時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me when you started and when you feel sleepy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三日前です。昼食後に飲み、その後一時間くらいで眠くなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開始日服用時刻と眠気の経過を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three days ago. I take it after lunch and became sleepy about an hour afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the start date, dose timing, and development of sleepiness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに飲んでいるものはありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 市販の薬もあります。手帳にないので、商品の写真を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 市販薬の写真も示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also take an over-the-counter medicine. It is not in the notebook, so I will show a photograph of the product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Also show a photograph of the over-the-counter medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will check them together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。自己判断で量を変えず、今の飲み方と症状を医師へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己変更せず医師へ飲み方相談を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not change the amount on my own and will discuss my current use and symptoms with the doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to consult the doctor about how you take it without changing it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 手帳と写真を担当へお見せください。飲む量の相談も診察でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the notebook and photograph to the responsible staff. Ask about the amount to take during your consultation as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お忘れ物についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a lost item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店で鞄をなくしました。防犯カメラがありましたが、自分に映像を見せてもらえるか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鞄紛失と映像閲覧可否の疑問を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost my bag in a shop. There was a security camera, but I do not know whether they can show me the footage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the lost bag and ask whether viewing the footage is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店へは鞄の確認を頼みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you asked the shop to check for the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。店内にはなかったそうです。映像を見られると店に約束されたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店へ確認済みで閲覧約束はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They said it was not inside. The shop has not promised that I can view the footage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you checked with the shop but were not promised a viewing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: なくした状況と時間を先に整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us first organize when and how it went missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夕方五時から六時の間です。席の横へ置き、会計後に気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紛失時間帯と置いた経緯を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Between five and six in the evening. I put it beside my seat and noticed after paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the time range and how you left the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鞄の特徴を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 灰色で、内側に名前の札があります。カメラがあるだけで誰かが盗ったと決めてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 特徴を示し盗難と未断定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is gray and has a name tag inside. I have not decided someone stole it just because there is a camera.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the bag and explain that you have not concluded it was stolen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報で相談を受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will accept your inquiry using that information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。店へ自分で映像の提出を強く求める前に、確認の進め方を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 映像要求前に確認手順を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Before strongly demanding that the shop provide the footage myself, I would like to ask how to proceed with checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the checking procedure before demanding footage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 特徴と経過を担当へ伝えます。映像に関する扱いも、担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the responsible staff its features and the circumstances. They will also explain how camera footage is handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 配送状況のお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this an inquiry about delivery status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ相手へ箱を二つ送りました。一つだけ届いたので、もう一つを調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二箱の片方未着を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I sent two boxes to the same person. Only one arrived, so I would like the other checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about one of two boxes not arriving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの番号は二つありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have two numbers on your receipts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。届いた方の番号だけ見て、両方届いたと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二番号と一件だけ見た誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I only looked at the number of the box that arrived and thought both had arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that there are two numbers and you misunderstood by checking only one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未着の箱の番号を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the number for the missing box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。宛先は同じでも、番号ごとに別の箱ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同宛先でも各箱の番号を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. Even with the same destination, each number refers to a different box, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish each box number even when the destination is the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手からいつ連絡がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When did the recipient contact you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の朝です。どちらの箱か分かるよう、外箱の写真も送ってもらいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の連絡時刻と箱写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This morning. I also asked them to send a photograph of the outer box so we could identify which one it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State when the recipient contacted you and show the box photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号と写真を合わせて担当へ伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can tell the responsible staff the number together with the photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。未着の一箱の状況として相談し、二箱とも届いていないとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未着一箱に対象を限定して依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I am asking about the one undelivered box and will not say that both boxes failed to arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Limit the request to the one undelivered box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの番号を確認します。未着の方を特定して、担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check both numbers, identify the one that has not arrived, and refer it to the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの操作についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about operating your card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番号を変えたのに、前の暗証番号を入れてしまいました。何度か試したら使えなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号変更後に旧番号反復で停止したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed the PIN but entered the old one. After trying several times, I could no longer use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that repeated old-PIN entries after a change caused the card to stop working. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は操作を止めていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。もう一回試せば通ると思って、入力を続けるのはやめました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再入力を止めたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I stopped continuing to enter it thinking one more try might work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you stopped trying to enter it again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認に必要な資料を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff will explain the documents needed for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。暗証番号そのものをここで声に出すのではなく、変更した日を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号を口頭開示せず変更日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than saying the PIN itself aloud here, I will tell you the day I changed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not disclose the PIN aloud; state the date of the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の資料とカードはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have your own identification documents and the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方あります。番号のメモを他人に渡して代わりに操作してもらうことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人資料カードを提示し他人に番号を渡さないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have both. I will not give someone a note with the PIN and have them operate it for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your identification and card and explain that you will not give others the PIN. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 解除や確認の手続きを聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask about the procedure for unlocking or checking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。カードの状態を確認してもらい、再利用できると説明されてから操作します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態確認後に再利用する意思を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will have the card status checked and only operate it after being told it can be used again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will use it again after its status is checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料とカードを担当へお見せください。暗証番号は人に見せずに保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the documents and card to the responsible staff. Keep the PIN stored without showing it to others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 割引券をご利用ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are using a discount coupon, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。かごの全部に使えると思いましたが、対象外の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: クーポン対象外表示を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought it applied to everything in my basket, but I see a notice about excluded items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the notice excluding items from the coupon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象を確認します。こちらの二品は対象外です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check eligibility. These two items are excluded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、その二品は割引なしの値段ですね。全体の金額を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象外二品と合計確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then those two are the regular price without a discount. I would like to decide after hearing the total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm the two excluded items and the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合計をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can tell you the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。割引券を使うだけで、対象外の品まで安くなるとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象商品だけの割引と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will remember that simply using the coupon does not make excluded items cheaper too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the discount applies only to eligible items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この合計額になります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予算を超えるので、対象外の一品は今日は買いません。もう一品はそのまま買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予算に合わせ一品だけ外す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It exceeds my budget, so I will not buy one of the excluded items today. I will still buy the other one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Remove just one item to stay within your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻す商品はこちらへお預けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hand us the item you want to return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この品を戻し、残りの数量と割引対象をもう一度確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 戻す品を示し数量割引を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here it is. Please put this item back and check the remaining quantity and discount eligibility again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the item to return and recheck quantities and discounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一品を外しました。残りの合計と割引内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: One item has been removed. Please check the remaining total and discount details.
